ACTIVE.description: Active (ACTIVE). Controls which objects are active in the current view; ACTIVE_MODE selects the operation and drives which of the other fields are consumed.

ACTIVE_MODE.description: Active operation mode (case-insensitive). 'All' activates everything (all other fields ignored); 'Active' activates the objects listed in N_LIST/E_LIST; 'Identity' activates objects matched by IDENTITY_TYPE + IDENTITY_LIST.

IDENTITY_TYPE.description: [ACTIVE_MODE=Identity] Category of identity to match against IDENTITY_LIST (case-insensitive). Required when ACTIVE_MODE=Identity.

IDENTITY_LIST.description: [ACTIVE_MODE=Identity] Names of the identity targets (stories/named planes/groups/etc.) to activate. Required and must be non-empty when ACTIVE_MODE=Identity.

STORY_ACTIVE.description: [ACTIVE_MODE=Identity, IDENTITY_TYPE=Story] Story activation option (case-insensitive): Floor (this floor), Above, Below, or Both.
